shots.visual_description: Close-up of dull, dry skin on a cheek, showing visible fine lines and slight flakiness. Dramatic, slightly cool lighting with a macro lens.
shots.narration: 你的皮肤是不是也经常干燥紧绷，细纹悄悄爬上脸？

shots.visual_description: Product hero shot of the玻尿酸面霜 bottle/jar, rotating slowly on a pristine white marble surface. Soft, diffused warm lighting creates a gentle glow.
shots.narration: 别担心！这款玻尿酸面霜，帮你告别干燥，重现水润光泽。

shots.visual_description: Close-up of a model's hand applying a pearl-sized amount of cream to one half of her face. Focus on gentle, upward massage strokes. Natural, bright lighting.
shots.narration: 质地轻盈，一点也不粘腻，轻轻一抹，肌肤立刻大口喝水。

shots.visual_description: Extreme close-up of the applied side of the face, showing instant absorption of the cream and a dewy, plump finish. Focus on improved skin texture.
shots.narration: 高纯玻尿酸深入肌底，层层补水，让肌肤由内而外嘭弹。
shots.text_overlay: 高纯玻尿酸 深度补水

shots.visual_description: Split-screen before/after. One side of the model's face is dull and dry (before), the other is plump, radiant, and smooth (after application). Bright, even studio lighting.
shots.narration: 看看这对比！使用后，干燥细纹明显改善，肌肤水润透亮。

shots.visual_description: Medium shot of the model gently touching her now hydrated face, smiling confidently. Her skin looks healthy and glowing. Soft, natural lighting.
shots.narration: 不止补水，更能锁住水分，长效保湿，肌肤一整天都Q弹。

shots.visual_description: Product array with multiple jars/bottles arranged attractively. A clear price tag overlay and a prominent '限时优惠' (limited offer) banner. Warm, inviting lighting.
shots.narration: 别再犹豫了！现在下单立享优惠，快让你的肌肤焕发新生吧！

market_summary.summary: 玻尿酸面霜市场广阔，消费者普遍面临皮肤干燥、细纹、屏障受损等问题，渴望高效补水保湿且成分安心的产品。
key_findings: 消费者对即时补水效果有强烈需求
成分透明度和安全性是购买决策关键
年轻群体更注重产品清爽不粘腻的使用感
